column1: # One row per session, tab-separated. Write - for a default.
#   name      exact session name; other sessions address their messages to it
#   dir       working folder; a leading ~ and $FM_HOME are expanded. An isolated role's folder holds no other
#             role's folder and sits inside none
#   model, effort  the launcher passes both at each launch. A resumed conversation re-reads its history uncached on
#             a new model, and on a new effort unless the model keeps the cache (Claude Code's prompt caching page
#             lists which do): change them with --new or right after the role compacts
#   rolefile  roles/<rolefile>.md and settings/<rolefile>.json (default: the role)
